zh: 开始吧。
en: Let's get started.
alt: Shall we get started?
Let's kick off.
point: ‘开始吧’ 没主语，要补 let's：Let's get started

zh: 搞定了。
en: That's all sorted.
alt: It's all done.
That's done and dusted.
point: ‘搞定了’ 要补主语 that's/it's，不能只说 Finish

zh: 又连不上Wi-Fi了。
en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi again.
alt: The Wi-Fi won't connect again.
point: 没主语，英文要补 I：I can't connect to …

zh: 又卡死了。
en: It's frozen again.
alt: It's hung again.
It's stuck again.
point: ‘卡死了’ 要补 it，用 It's frozen

zh: 吃饱了，谢谢。
en: I'm full, thanks.
alt: I'm stuffed, thanks.
I couldn't eat another bite.
point: ‘吃饱了’ 要补 I'm：I'm full，不说 Eat full

zh: 可以点菜了。
en: We're ready to order.
alt: We'd like to order now.
point: ‘可以点菜了’ 要补 we，用 ready to order

zh: 开始了！
en: It's kicked off!
alt: The game's started!
They've kicked off!
point: ‘开始了’ 要补 it，用完成时 It's kicked off

zh: 跑不动了。
en: I can't run any more.
alt: I can't run any further.
point: ‘跑不动了’ 补 I，用 can't … any more

zh: 有点贵了。
en: It's a bit pricey.
alt: That's a bit dear.
It's a bit expensive.
point: 形容词前要补 it's：It's a bit pricey

zh: 随便看看，谢谢。
en: I'm just looking, thanks.
alt: I'm just browsing, thanks.
point: ‘随便看看’ 要补 I'm：I'm just looking

zh: 到了吗？
en: Are we there yet?
alt: Have we arrived?
point: ‘到了吗’ 要说 Are we there yet，不说 Arrive?

zh: 赶不上飞机了。
en: We're going to miss our flight.
alt: We won't make our flight.
point: ‘赶不上’ 要补 we，用 miss / won't make

zh: 好多了。
en: I'm feeling much better.
alt: I feel a lot better.
point: ‘好多了’ 要补 I'm feeling，不说 Much good

zh: 这儿疼。
en: It hurts here.
alt: It's sore here.
I've got a pain here.
point: ‘这儿疼’ 要补 it：It hurts here

zh: 又下雨了。
en: It's raining again.
alt: It's pouring again.
point: 天气句要用 it 作主语：It's raining

zh: 吃饭了，快来！
en: Dinner's ready, come and get it!
alt: Dinner's on the table, come and eat!
point: ‘吃饭了’ 不是 Eat rice，要说 Dinner's ready

zh: 改天吧。
en: Let's do it another time.
alt: Maybe another time.
Can we make it another day?
point: ‘改天吧’ 要说 Let's … another time

zh: 该走了。
en: I'd better get going.
alt: I should head off.
Time for me to go.
point: ‘该走了’ 要补 I，常说 I'd better get going

zh: 不用找了。
en: Keep the change.
alt: You can keep the change.
point: ‘不用找了’ 说 Keep the change，不说 Don't need find

zh: 可以付现金吗？
en: Can I pay in cash?
alt: Do you take cash?
Is cash OK?
point: ‘可以…吗’ 要补 I：Can I pay in cash?

zh: 下周一再说吧，今天太忙了。
en: Let's talk about it next Monday, I'm flat out today.
alt: Can we deal with it on Monday? I'm too busy today.
point: 两个分句都没主语，要补 let's 和 I'm

zh: 来不及了，能不能延到周五？
en: We won't make the deadline. Can we push it back to Friday?
alt: We're not going to get it done in time — could we move it to Friday?
point: ‘来不及’ 要补 we，用 won't make it / the deadline

zh: 装好了，重启一下就能用了。
en: It's installed. Just restart and you're good to go.
alt: It's all installed — once you restart, it'll work.
point: ‘装好了’ 要补 it's，‘就能用了’ 补 you

zh: 报错了，不知道怎么回事。
en: It's throwing an error and I've got no idea why.
alt: I'm getting an error and I don't know what's going on.
point: ‘报错了’ 要补 it/I，用 throw / get an error

zh: 吃不完了，能打包吗？
en: I can't finish this. Could I get it to take away?
alt: I can't eat any more — can I get a box for this?
point: ‘吃不完’ 要补 I；打包说 take away / a box

zh: 订了位，七点，四个人。
en: We've got a booking for four at seven.
alt: We booked a table for four at 7.
point: 省略句要补 we，用 have a booking for

zh: 输了，不过踢得其实还不错。
en: We lost, but we actually played pretty well.
alt: We didn't win, but it was a decent game.
point: 两个分句都要补 we，不能只说 Lost, but played well

zh: 刚跑了五公里，累死了。
en: I've just done a 5k run and I'm knackered.
alt: I just ran five kilometres and I'm exhausted.
point: 两个分句都要补 I；‘累死了’ 说 knackered

zh: 能试一下吗？没有合适的尺码就算了。
en: Can I try it on? If you don't have my size, never mind.
alt: Could I try this on? If there's nothing in my size, don't worry about it.
point: ‘试一下’ 补 I + try on；‘就算了’ 说 never mind

zh: 不好意思，卖完了，下周才到货。
en: Sorry, we've sold out, but we're getting more in next week.
alt: Sorry, they're all gone — new stock arrives next week.
point: ‘卖完了’ 要补 we've sold out；到货 = get more in

zh: 快到了，再过十分钟左右。
en: We're nearly there, just another ten minutes or so.
alt: We're almost there — about ten more minutes.
point: ‘快到了’ 要补 we're：We're nearly there

zh: 堵车了，可能要晚半个小时。
en: I'm stuck in traffic, so I'll probably be half an hour late.
alt: There's heaps of traffic, I might be about 30 minutes late.
point: ‘堵车了’ 用 I'm stuck in traffic，‘要晚’ 补 I'll

zh: 感冒了，今天在家休息。
en: I've caught a cold, so I'm resting at home today.
alt: I've got a cold, so I'm staying home today.
point: ‘感冒了’ 要补 I：I've got a cold，不是 Cold

zh: 扭到脚了，走路一瘸一拐的。
en: I've twisted my ankle and I'm limping a bit.
alt: I rolled my ankle, so I'm hobbling around.
point: ‘扭到脚了’ 补 I've，脚踝用 ankle 不用 foot

zh: 停电了，冰箱里的东西要坏了。
en: There's a power cut and the food in the fridge is going to go off.
alt: The power's out, and the stuff in the fridge will go bad.
point: ‘停电了’ 说 There's a power cut / The power's out

zh: 周五该交房租了，别忘了。
en: The rent's due on Friday, so don't forget.
alt: Don't forget the rent needs paying on Friday.
point: ‘该交房租了’ 要说 the rent's due

zh: 好久没见了，最近怎么样？
en: It's been ages! How have you been lately?
alt: Long time no see — how's it going?
point: ‘好久没见’ 补 it's been ages；‘最近怎么样’ 用完成时

zh: 到家了吗？到了给我发个消息。
en: Are you home yet? Text me when you get there.
alt: Have you got home? Send me a message once you're back.
point: ‘到家了吗’ 要补 you；‘到了’ 用 when you get there

zh: 扣了两次钱，能帮我查一下吗？
en: I've been charged twice. Could you look into it for me?
alt: It's taken the money out twice — can you check it for me?
point: ‘扣了两次钱’ 要补主语，说 I've been charged twice

zh: 退款到了吗？说是三到五个工作日。
en: Has the refund come through yet? They said three to five working days.
alt: Have you got the refund yet? It's supposed to take 3–5 business days.
point: ‘到了吗’ 说 has it come through；‘说是’ 补 they said

zh: 收到，今天下班前改好发给你，有问题再说。
en: Got it, I'll make the changes and send it over before the end of the day. Let me know if anything comes up.
alt: Will do — I'll have it updated and back to you by end of day. Give me a shout if there are any issues.
point: ‘改好发给你’ 全省主语，要补 I'll 和 let me know

zh: 开会说了半天，最后也没定下来，只能下周再讨论了。
en: We went round in circles for ages and didn't decide anything, so we'll have to pick it up again next week.
alt: The meeting dragged on but nothing got decided, so we'll revisit it next week.
point: 整句无主语，要补 we；‘说了半天’ 用 go round in circles

zh: 已经回滚了，暂时恢复了，不过根本原因还没找到。
en: We've rolled it back and it's working again for now, but we still haven't found the root cause.
alt: It's been rolled back and things are up again for the moment, but we haven't pinned down the root cause yet.
point: 三个分句都缺主语，要补 we/it；‘还没找到’ 用 haven't … yet

zh: 部署到一半就挂了，看了日志，好像是权限的问题。
en: The deployment fell over halfway through. I've checked the logs and it looks like a permissions issue.
alt: It died halfway through the deploy — from the logs, it seems to be a permissions problem.
point: ‘挂了’ 补主语 + fell over；‘好像是’ 用 it looks like

zh: 等了快一个小时了，问了两次，还是说马上就好。
en: We've been waiting nearly an hour for our food, and we've asked twice, but they keep saying it's on its way.
alt: It's been almost an hour and still no food — we've chased it up twice and they just keep saying it's coming.
point: 整句省主语，要补 we；‘等了快一小时’ 用完成进行时

zh: 吃得差不多了，买单吧，今天我请，上次是你付的。
en: We're about done, so let's get the bill. It's my shout today, you paid last time.
alt: Shall we get the bill? This one's on me — you got it last time.
point: 全句省主语；‘我请’ 说 it's my shout / it's on me

zh: 看了上半场觉得没戏了，就关了电视，结果最后十分钟连得两个达阵。
en: I watched the first half, thought it was all over and switched off, then they scored two tries in the last ten minutes.
alt: I gave up at half-time and turned the TV off, and of course they got two tries in the last ten minutes.
point: 中文一路省主语，英文每个分句都要补 I / they

zh: 报名了半马，还有两个月，得开始认真练了。
en: I've signed up for a half marathon in two months, so I really need to start training properly.
alt: I've entered a half marathon and it's only two months away, so it's time to get serious about training.
point: ‘报名了’ 补 I，用 sign up for；‘得…了’ 说 need to

zh: 网上买的，到了才发现尺寸不对，能退吗？
en: I bought it online, but when it arrived it was the wrong size. Can I return it?
alt: I ordered this online and it turned out to be the wrong size — could I get a refund?
point: 每个分句都补主语 I/it；‘到了才发现’ 用 when it arrived

zh: 看了好几家，还是 Warehouse 最便宜，就在那儿买了。
en: I looked around a few shops and The Warehouse was the cheapest, so I ended up buying it there.
alt: After shopping around, The Warehouse had the best price, so that's where I got it.
point: ‘看了好几家’ 补 I，用 shop around；‘就在那儿买了’ 用 ended up

zh: 落地了，在等行李，估计还要半个小时才能出来。
en: We've just landed and I'm waiting for my bag, so it'll probably be another half hour before I'm out.
alt: I've just touched down — still waiting on my luggage, so I reckon another 30 minutes.
point: ‘落地了 / 在等行李’ 都要补主语 we've / I'm

zh: 出发前查一下天气，听说南岛这几天可能下雪。
en: Check the weather before we head off — apparently it might snow in the South Island this week.
alt: Have a look at the forecast before we leave; I heard it could snow down south over the next few days.
point: ‘可能下雪’ 补 it：it might snow；‘出发前’ 补 we

zh: 最近老是睡不好，早上起来头疼，是不是该去看看医生了？
en: I haven't been sleeping well lately and I keep waking up with a headache. Do you think I should see a GP?
alt: I've been sleeping badly and getting headaches in the mornings — maybe it's time I saw a doctor?
point: 补 I，用完成进行时；‘看医生’ 说 see a GP

zh: 约了下午三点看牙，可能要晚点到，手上的事还没弄完。
en: I've got a dentist appointment at three, but I might be a bit late — I'm still finishing something off.
alt: My dentist appointment's at 3, but I'm running a bit behind because I haven't wrapped up what I'm doing.
point: 三个分句都省主语；‘还没弄完’ 用 still finishing off

zh: 水龙头又漏水了，跟房东说了好几次，一直没人来修。
en: The tap's leaking again. I've told the landlord several times, but no one's come to fix it.
alt: The tap's dripping again — I've mentioned it to the landlord a few times and nobody's sorted it.
point: ‘说了好几次’ 补 I've；‘没人来修’ 用 no one's come

zh: 搬进来才发现没有暖气，冬天估计会很冷。
en: We only realised after moving in that there's no heating, so it's going to be freezing in winter.
alt: It wasn't until we moved in that we found out there's no heater — winter's going to be cold.
point: 补 we；‘会很冷’ 天气要用 it's going to be

zh: 本来想去的，临时有事去不了了，下次一定！
en: I was really keen to come, but something's come up and I can't make it. Next time for sure!
alt: I'd planned to come, but something came up last minute so I'll have to give it a miss — definitely next time!
point: ‘去不了’ 用 can't make it；‘临时有事’ 说 something's come up

zh: 聊得挺开心的，不知不觉就十二点了，该回去了。
en: We were having such a good time that we lost track of time — it's already midnight, so I'd better make a move.
alt: Time flew while we were chatting — it's midnight already, I should head home.
point: 补 we/it；‘不知不觉’ 说 lose track of time

zh: 工资还没到账，这周先帮我垫一下，下周还你。
en: My pay hasn't come in yet. Could you cover me this week? I'll pay you back next week.
alt: I haven't been paid yet — could you lend me some money this week? I'll give it back next week.
point: ‘先帮我垫一下’ 补 you，用 cover me；‘还你’ 补 I'll

zh: 算了一下，每个月扣掉房租和生活费，剩不下多少，得重新做个预算。
en: I've crunched the numbers, and after rent and living costs there's not much left each month, so we need to redo our budget.
alt: Once the rent and bills come out each month there's hardly anything left — we'll have to rework the budget.
point: ‘算了一下’ 补 I've；‘剩不下多少’ 用 there's not much left

zh: 下班了，明天见。
en: That's me for the day. See you tomorrow.
alt: I'm off home now, see you tomorrow.
point: ‘下班了’ 不说 Off work，常说 That's me for the day

zh: 手机快没电了。
en: My phone's about to die.
alt: My phone's nearly out of battery.
point: ‘快没电了’ 不说 No electricity，说 about to die

zh: 还没想好，再等一下。
en: We're still deciding, give us a minute.
alt: We haven't decided yet. Could we have a few more minutes?
point: ‘还没想好’ 补 we're，说 still deciding

zh: 平了。
en: It's a draw.
alt: It ended in a draw.
point: ‘平了’ 补 it，说 It's a draw，不说 Flat

zh: 就要这个了。
en: I'll take this one.
alt: I'll get this one.
point: ‘就要这个了’ 补 I'll，用 take 表示决定买

zh: 护照忘带了！
en: I've forgotten my passport!
alt: I've left my passport behind!
point: ‘忘带了’ 补 I've，不说 Forget bring

zh: 嗓子疼。
en: I've got a sore throat.
alt: My throat's sore.
point: ‘嗓子疼’ 不说 Throat pain，要说 I've got a sore throat

zh: 饭糊了！
en: I've burnt the dinner!
alt: The dinner's burnt!
point: ‘糊了’ 补 I've，说 burnt，不说 Rice paste

zh: 到了，你在哪儿？
en: I'm here, where are you?
alt: I've arrived. Where are you?
point: ‘到了’ 补 I'm，说 I'm here，不说 Arrived

zh: 刷不了卡。
en: My card isn't working.
alt: My card's been declined.
point: ‘刷不了’ 要补主语 my card，说 isn't working

zh: 面上了！
en: I got the job!
alt: I've got the job!
point: ‘面上了’ 补 I，说 got the job，不说 Interview pass

zh: 还没回音。
en: I haven't heard back yet.
alt: I'm still waiting to hear back.
point: ‘没回音’ 补 I，用 hear back

zh: 辞职了。
en: I've quit my job.
alt: I've handed in my notice.
point: ‘辞职了’ 补 I've，quit 后面要带 my job

zh: 考过了！
en: I passed!
alt: I passed the exam!
point: ‘考过了’ 补 I，用 pass，不说 Exam over

zh: 听不懂。
en: I can't follow.
alt: I'm lost.
I don't get it.
point: ‘听不懂’ 补 I，常说 I can't follow / I'm lost

zh: 上课要迟到了！
en: I'm going to be late for class!
alt: I'll be late for class!
point: ‘要迟到了’ 补 I'm，用 going to be late for

zh: 搬好了。
en: We're all moved in.
alt: We've moved in.
point: ‘搬好了’ 补 we，说 moved in

zh: 押金退了吗？
en: Have you got your bond back?
alt: Did you get your bond back?
point: ‘退了吗’ 补 you，说 get your bond back

zh: 下周去看房。
en: We've got a viewing next week.
alt: We're going to a viewing next week.
point: ‘看房’ 补 we've got，用名词 a viewing

zh: 太吵了，睡不着。
en: It's too noisy, I can't sleep.
alt: It's so loud I can't get to sleep.
point: 两个分句分别补 it's 和 I

zh: 又把车停我家门口了。
en: They've parked across my driveway again.
alt: They've blocked my driveway again.
point: 补 they；挡车道说 park across my driveway

zh: 猫丢了，你见过吗？
en: Our cat's gone missing. Have you seen her?
alt: We've lost our cat. Have you seen her around?
point: ‘丢了’ 说 gone missing；‘见过吗’ 补 you

zh: 断网了。
en: The internet's down.
alt: We've lost the internet.
point: ‘断网了’ 说 the internet's down，不说 Break net

zh: 热水用完了。
en: We've run out of hot water.
alt: The hot water's run out.
point: ‘用完了’ 补 we've，说 run out of

zh: 这儿没信号。
en: I've got no reception here.
alt: I can't get any signal here.
point: ‘没信号’ 补 I，手机信号常说 reception

zh: 修好了。
en: It's fixed.
alt: It's all sorted now.
point: ‘修好了’ 补 it's，用过去分词 fixed

zh: 洗衣机又坏了。
en: The washing machine's broken down again.
alt: The washing machine's stopped working again.
point: 机器坏了用 break down，不说 is bad

zh: 什么时候能过来？
en: When can you come round?
alt: When could you pop over?
point: ‘能过来’ 补 you，上门说 come round

zh: 预约好了。
en: I've made an appointment.
alt: I've booked an appointment.
point: ‘预约好了’ 补 I've，说 made an appointment

zh: 表填好了。
en: I've filled in the form.
alt: I've filled out the form.
point: 补 I've；填表说 fill in / fill out

zh: 排了一个小时的队。
en: I queued for an hour.
alt: I was in the queue for an hour.
point: 补 I，排队说 queue，不说 line up the team

zh: 着火了！
en: There's a fire!
alt: Something's on fire!
point: ‘着火了’ 说 There's a fire，不说 Fire start

zh: 钥匙锁车里了。
en: I've locked my keys in the car.
alt: I've locked myself out of the car.
point: 补 I've；锁在里面说 lock … in the car

zh: 已经叫救护车了。
en: I've already called an ambulance.
alt: An ambulance is on its way.
point: ‘叫了救护车’ 补 I've，冠词 an 不能丢

zh: 快没油了。
en: We're nearly out of petrol.
alt: We're running low on petrol.
point: ‘快没油了’ 补 we're；新西兰说 petrol 不说 gas

zh: 到站了，下车吧。
en: This is our stop, let's get off.
alt: Here's our stop, let's hop off.
point: ‘到站了’ 说 This is our stop，‘下车吧’ 补 let's

zh: 又吃了张罚单。
en: I got another parking ticket.
alt: I've got another parking ticket.
point: ‘吃罚单’ 补 I，说 got a parking ticket

zh: 太晒了。
en: The sun's really strong.
alt: It's scorching.
The sun's fierce today.
point: ‘太晒了’ 要补主语 the sun / it，不说 Too sun

zh: 起风了。
en: It's getting windy.
alt: The wind's picking up.
point: ‘起风了’ 用 it's getting windy

zh: 走不动了，歇会儿吧。
en: I'm done in, let's have a break.
alt: I'm buggered, let's stop for a bit.
point: 补 I'm / let's；累坏了说 done in

zh: 那部电影看过了。
en: I've already seen that film.
alt: I've seen that movie already.
point: ‘看过了’ 补 I've，加 already

zh: 该剪头发了。
en: I need a haircut.
alt: I'm due for a haircut.
point: ‘该剪头发了’ 说 I need a haircut，不说 Should cut hair

zh: 好看吗？
en: Was it any good?
alt: Was it good?
Did you enjoy it?
point: 问电影好不好要补 it：Was it any good?

zh: 太破费了！
en: You shouldn't have!
alt: Oh, you really shouldn't have!
point: 收礼说 You shouldn't have，要补 you

zh: 过年回家吗？
en: Are you going home for Chinese New Year?
alt: Are you heading home for Chinese New Year?
point: 补 you；回家过节说 go home for

zh: 订婚了！
en: We're engaged!
alt: We've got engaged!
point: ‘订婚了’ 补 we're，engaged 是形容词

zh: 终于睡着了。
en: She's finally asleep.
alt: He's finally gone to sleep.
point: 补 she's / he's，‘睡着了’ 用形容词 asleep

zh: 作业写完了吗？
en: Have you finished your homework?
alt: Is your homework done?
point: 补 you，‘写完作业’ 说 finish your homework

zh: 该接孩子了。
en: It's time to pick up the kids.
alt: I need to go and get the kids.
point: ‘该…了’ 说 It's time to …

zh: 又掉毛了。
en: She's shedding again.
alt: He's moulting again.

alt: My new fridge was delivered with a visible dent; I'm requesting a replacement or a full refund.

alt: The earthquake has left a number of cracks in our home; I've photographed them and would appreciate an assessor visiting promptly.
point: ‘已拍照’ 补 I've；‘派人上门’ 说 come out

zh: 车辆被盗已报警，报案号附后，现向贵公司申请理赔。
en: My car's been stolen and I've reported it to the police. The reference number is below, and I'd now like to make a claim.
alt: I'm writing to claim for my stolen car, which I've reported to police — the file number is included below.
point: ‘已报警’ 补 I've reported；‘附后’ 说 is below

zh: 罚单所列时间车辆正在修车厂，随附维修单据，请撤销该罚单。
en: At the time shown on the ticket, my car was at the garage being repaired. I've attached the invoice and would ask that the fine be withdrawn.
alt: My vehicle was in for repairs at the time of the alleged offence; please see the attached invoice and cancel the infringement.
point: ‘随附’ 补 I've attached；‘请撤销’ 用 would ask that … be withdrawn

zh: 买车时卖方隐瞒了事故记录，要求退车或赔偿差价。
en: The seller didn't disclose the car's accident history when I bought it, so I'm seeking either a refund or compensation for the difference.
alt: The car's accident history was concealed from me at the time of sale; I'm asking for a full refund or compensation.
point: 补 I；‘要求’ 正式说 I'm seeking

zh: 每天通勤都要走这段路，强烈建议增设人行横道。
en: I walk along this stretch of road every day on my commute, and I'd strongly recommend that a pedestrian crossing be added.
alt: As someone who walks this road daily to get to work, I'd urge the council to install a pedestrian crossing.
point: ‘每天要走’ 补 I；‘强烈建议’ 说 I'd strongly recommend

zh: 航班取消后被迫多住一晚，产生的住宿和餐饮费用希望能够报销。
en: After the flight was cancelled, we had to stay an extra night, and I'd like to be reimbursed for the hotel and meals.
alt: The cancellation forced us to stay an additional night, so I'm requesting reimbursement for our accommodation and meals.
point: ‘被迫多住’ 补 we had to；‘报销’ 说 be reimbursed

zh: 行李延误三天才送到，期间只好购买必需品，附上收据申请赔偿。
en: My luggage arrived three days late, so I had to buy essentials in the meantime. I've attached the receipts and would like to claim for these.
alt: As my bag was delayed by three days, I had to purchase essentials; the receipts are attached for reimbursement.
point: 补 I；‘申请赔偿’ 说 claim for

zh: 预订时特别注明需要无障碍房间，入住时却被安排在三楼，还没有电梯。
en: When I booked, I specifically requested an accessible room, but on arrival we were put on the third floor with no lift.
alt: Despite my request for an accessible room at the time of booking, we were given a third-floor room with no lift access.
point: ‘注明’ 补 I specifically requested；电梯说 lift

zh: 步道入口的指示牌坏了，容易走错路，建议尽快更换。
en: The sign at the start of the track has been damaged and it's easy to take the wrong path, so I'd recommend replacing it soon.
alt: The signpost at the track entrance is broken, which makes it easy to get lost — it would be good to have it replaced promptly.
point: ‘容易走错’ 补 it's easy to；‘建议’ 补 I'd recommend

zh: 计划下月在公园办社区野餐，约五十人，想了解是否需要申请许可。
en: We're planning a community picnic in the park next month for about fifty people and would like to know whether we need a permit.
alt: Our group is organising a picnic for around fifty in the park next month — could you tell us if a permit is required?
point: 补 we're；‘想了解’ 说 would like to know whether

zh: 营地订好后因暴雨封路去不了，请求退还订金。
en: We were unable to reach the campsite because the road was closed due to heavy rain, so we'd like to request a refund of our deposit.
alt: Heavy rain closed the road and we couldn't get to the campsite, so I'm asking for our deposit back.
point: ‘去不了’ 补 we were unable to reach；‘请求退还’ 说 request a refund

zh: 想给儿子报名少年橄榄球队，请告知训练时间和所需装备。
en: I'd like to register my son for the junior rugby team. Could you let me know the training times and what gear he'll need?
alt: I'm interested in signing my son up for junior rugby — what are the training times, and what equipment does he need?
point: 补 I'd like to / he'll；装备说 gear

zh: 健身房会员到期后仍被扣费，已多次要求取消，请退还多扣的钱。
en: I've continued to be charged after my gym membership ended, despite asking to cancel several times. Please refund the extra payments.
alt: Although my membership has expired and I've asked repeatedly to cancel, I'm still being debited — please refund these charges.
point: 补 I've；‘已多次要求’ 用 despite asking

zh: 作为俱乐部成员，建议本赛季增设女子组，相信能吸引更多会员。
en: As a club member, I'd like to propose adding a women's grade this season, as I believe it would attract more members.
alt: Speaking as a member, I think introducing a women's team this season would help the club grow.
point: ‘建议’ 补 I'd like to propose；‘相信’ 说 I believe

zh: 演出临时取消，主办方只给部分退款，这显然不合理。
en: The show was cancelled at short notice and we've only been offered a partial refund, which I don't think is reasonable.
alt: The organisers cancelled the event at the last minute and are only refunding part of the ticket price, which I find unacceptable.
point: 补 we've / I；‘显然不合理’ 说 I don't think is reasonable

zh: 借的书不小心弄坏了，愿意照价赔偿，请告知具体金额。
en: I've accidentally damaged a library book and I'm happy to pay for a replacement. Could you let me know how much it will be?
alt: Unfortunately I've damaged one of the books I borrowed — please tell me the replacement cost and I'll pay it.
point: ‘愿意赔偿’ 说 I'm happy to pay；‘告知金额’ 说 Could you let me know

zh: 想申请加入摄影俱乐部，附上几张作品，期待有机会参加活动。
en: I'd like to apply to join the photography club and have attached a few samples of my work. I hope to be able to take part soon.
alt: I'm keen to become a member of the photography club; please find some of my photos attached.
point: ‘想申请’ 补 I'd like to；‘期待’ 说 I hope to

zh: 诚邀您出席本周六的社区晚宴，届时将欢迎新成员，敬请回复是否出席。
en: We'd like to invite you to our community dinner this Saturday, where we'll be welcoming new members. Please let us know if you can attend.
alt: You're warmly invited to our community dinner on Saturday to welcome our new members — kindly RSVP.
point: ‘诚邀’ 说 We'd like to invite you；‘敬请回复’ 说 Please let us know

zh: 非常感谢您昨天在俱乐部的演讲，受益匪浅，希望以后还有机会合作。
en: Thank you so much for your talk at the club yesterday. I got a great deal out of it and hope we can work together again.
alt: Many thanks for speaking at our club yesterday — it was really valuable, and I'd love to collaborate again in future.
point: ‘受益匪浅’ 说 I got a great deal out of it；‘希望合作’ 补 we

zh: 因临时出差，无法出席周五的聚会，深表歉意，请代我向大家问好。
en: Unfortunately I've been called away on a work trip and won't be able to attend on Friday. Please pass on my apologies and best wishes to everyone.
alt: I'm sorry, but a last-minute business trip means I'll miss Friday's gathering — please send everyone my regards.
point: ‘无法出席’ 补 I won't be able to；‘代我问好’ 说 pass on my best wishes

zh: 感谢各位百忙之中参加婚礼，招待不周之处还请见谅。
en: Thank you all for taking the time to come to our wedding, and please forgive us if we've overlooked anything.
alt: We're so grateful you made time to celebrate with us, and we apologise if anything fell short on the day.
point: ‘招待不周’ 无直译，说 forgive us if we've overlooked anything

zh: 家中有丧事，需请三天丧假，手头工作已交接给同事。
en: I've had a bereavement in the family and need to take three days' bereavement leave. I've handed my work over to a colleague.
alt: Due to a death in the family, I'll be on bereavement leave for three days; a colleague is covering my work.
point: 补 I've；‘已交接’ 说 handed my work over

zh: 春节期间照常营业，除夕当天提前两小时关门。
en: We'll be open as usual over Chinese New Year, but we'll be closing two hours early on New Year's Eve.
alt: Our hours are unchanged during the Lunar New Year, except on New Year's Eve, when we'll close two hours early.
point: 店铺通知补 we'll；‘照常营业’ 说 open as usual

zh: 孩子下周起请假两周随家人回国，期间的作业会按时补交。
en: My daughter will be away for two weeks from next week as we're travelling back to China, and she'll make sure she catches up on her schoolwork.
alt: We're taking our daughter to China for two weeks from next week; she'll complete any work she misses.
point: 补 we're / she'll；‘补交作业’ 说 catch up on her schoolwork

zh: 孩子在学校多次被同学欺负，希望校方高度重视，尽快安排面谈。
en: My son has been bullied by classmates on several occasions. I'd ask the school to take this seriously and arrange a meeting as soon as possible.
alt: I'm writing because my son has been repeatedly bullied at school, and I'd like to meet with you urgently to discuss it.
point: ‘希望校方重视’ 补 I'd ask the school to；‘面谈’ 说 arrange a meeting

zh: 想咨询一下幼儿园还有没有空位，孩子明年二月满三岁。
en: I'm enquiring whether you have any places available, as my son turns three next February.
alt: Could you tell me if you have any spaces coming up? My son will be three next February.
point: ‘想咨询’ 说 I'm enquiring whether；英式拼写 enquire

zh: 现申请在租住的房子里养一只室内小猫，如有需要愿意另付宠物押金。
en: I'd like to request permission to keep a small indoor cat at the property, and I'm happy to pay a pet bond if required.
alt: Would you consider allowing us to have an indoor cat? We'd be willing to pay a pet bond if needed.
point: ‘现申请’ 说 I'd like to request permission；‘愿意’ 说 I'm happy to

zh: 手术后狗的情况恶化，对诊所的处理方式有疑问，请提供完整病历。
en: My dog's condition got worse after the operation, and I have some concerns about how it was handled. Could you please provide his full records?
alt: Following surgery my dog deteriorated, and I'm concerned about the treatment he received — please send me his complete clinical records.
point: ‘有疑问’ 补 I have some concerns；‘请提供’ 用 Could you provide

zh: 附近一只狗多次在公园不拴绳并扑人，希望市政加强管理。
en: A dog in our area has repeatedly been let off the lead in the park and jumped at people. I'd like the council to look into this.
alt: I'm concerned about a local dog that's often off-lead in the park and has jumped on people — could the council please follow it up?
point: ‘希望市政’ 补 I'd like the council to；拴绳说 on the lead

zh: 对上周会议上的不当言论深感抱歉，今后会更加注意。
en: I sincerely apologise for my inappropriate comments at last week's meeting, and I'll be more careful in future.
alt: I'd like to apologise for what I said at last week's meeting; it was out of line and won't happen again.
point: ‘深感抱歉’ 补 I sincerely apologise；英式拼写 apologise

zh: 压力大的时候，一般先排好优先级，再逐项处理，必要时也会寻求帮助。
en: When I'm under pressure, I usually start by prioritising my tasks, then work through them one by one, and I'm not afraid to ask for help.
alt: I handle stress by setting clear priorities and tackling things one at a time, and I'll ask for support when I need it.
point: 面试回答要补 I；‘必要时求助’ 说 I'm not afraid to ask for help

zh: 对处理结果仍然不满意，保留进一步投诉的权利。
en: I remain dissatisfied with the outcome, and I reserve the right to take this complaint further.
alt: I'm still not satisfied with how this has been resolved and may escalate the matter.
point: 补 I；‘保留…权利’ 说 reserve the right to

zh: 也不是说方案不好，就是觉得时间上有点赶，要不再缓一缓？
en: It's not that I don't like the plan, I just think the timeline's a bit tight. Could we hold off for a week or two?
alt: I'm on board with the plan in principle, but the timing feels rushed — would it hurt to push it back a little?
point: ‘也不是说’ 说 It's not that …；‘缓一缓’ 说 hold off

zh: 今天就到这儿吧，剩下的明天接着弄，大家辛苦了。
en: Let's call it a day and pick up where we left off tomorrow. Thanks for all your hard work, everyone.
alt: Let's leave it there for today and carry on tomorrow — cheers for all the effort, team.
point: ‘就到这儿吧’ 说 let's call it a day；‘辛苦了’ 要换成道谢

zh: 很想帮忙，手上实在排满了，要是周五还没人接，再来找我。
en: I'd love to help, but I'm snowed under right now. If nobody's picked it up by Friday, give me a nudge.
alt: I'd really like to, but my plate's full at the moment — if it's still going begging on Friday, come back to me.
point: ‘排满了’ 说 I'm snowed under；‘再来找我’ 说 give me a nudge

zh: 说实话，重写不太现实，先打个补丁顶着，下个季度再从长计议。
en: To be honest, a rewrite isn't really on the cards, so let's patch it for now and look at it properly next quarter.
alt: Realistically, rebuilding it isn't going to happen — let's put a band-aid on it and revisit it next quarter.
point: ‘不太现实’ 说 isn't on the cards；‘先顶着’ 补 let's patch it for now

zh: 奇怪，在我电脑上是好的啊，要不你开个无痕窗口再试试？
en: Funnily enough, it works fine on my machine. Maybe try it in a private window and see if that does the trick?
alt: Weird — it's working for me. Could you try an incognito window and see if that sorts it?
point: ‘是好的’ 补 it works fine；‘试试看’ 说 see if that does the trick

zh: 不好说，可能是网络，也可能是服务器那边，等看了日志再下结论吧。
en: It's hard to say. It could be the network or it could be on the server side, so I'd rather not jump to conclusions until we've seen the logs.
alt: Hard to tell at this stage — could be network, could be the server. Let's see what the logs say before we decide.
point: ‘不好说’ 说 It's hard to say；‘下结论’ 说 jump to conclusions

zh: 待遇还行吧，就是通勤太远了，想再考虑考虑，不急着答复。
en: The package isn't bad, but the commute's a killer, so I'd like to sleep on it rather than rush into anything.
alt: The pay's decent enough, but that commute would be brutal — I'll mull it over before I say yes.
point: ‘再考虑考虑’ 说 sleep on it；‘还行吧’ 说 isn't bad

zh: 说是“还在走流程”，都三个星期了，估计是没戏了。
en: They keep saying it's "still going through the process", but it's been three weeks, so I reckon I'm out of the running.
alt: Three weeks of "we're still working through it" — I think it's safe to say I didn't get it.
point: ‘说是’ 补 they keep saying；‘没戏了’ 说 out of the running

zh: 要是问为什么离职，就说想找新的挑战，跟老板闹得不愉快就别提了。
en: If they ask why you're leaving, just say you're after a new challenge. I wouldn't mention that things went sour with your boss.
alt: If it comes up, frame it as wanting a fresh challenge — best not to bring up the falling-out with your manager.
point: 补 they / you；‘闹得不愉快’ 说 things went sour

zh: 临时抱佛脚肯定不行，还是得每天看一点，不然到时候哭都来不及。
en: Cramming the night before won't cut it. You've got to chip away at it every day, or you'll be kicking yourself come exam time.
alt: Leaving it to the last minute won't work — do a bit each day, or you'll regret it when the exams roll around.
point: ‘肯定不行’ 说 won't cut it；‘哭都来不及’ 说 kicking yourself

zh: 老师人挺好，就是讲得有点快，跟不太上，又不好意思老打断。
en: The tutor's lovely, but she goes a bit fast and I struggle to keep up, and I feel awkward interrupting all the time.
alt: I really like the tutor, but she speeds through things and I get left behind — and I don't want to keep putting my hand up.
point: ‘跟不上’ 补 I struggle to keep up；‘不好意思’ 说 I feel awkward

zh: 要不是你帮我改论文，估计真挂了，这顿我请，别跟我抢。
en: If you hadn't looked over my essay, I'd probably have failed, so dinner's on me and I won't take no for an answer.
alt: I'd have flunked without your help on that essay — let me buy you dinner, and don't even think about arguing.
point: ‘要不是’ 用虚拟 If you hadn't；‘别抢’ 说 won't take no

zh: 不是说好了轮流洗碗吗？怎么水池又堆满了。
en: I thought we'd agreed to take turns doing the dishes. How come the sink's full again?
alt: Weren't we meant to be taking turns with the washing-up? The sink's piled high again.
point: ‘不是说好了…吗’ 说 I thought we'd agreed；补 we

zh: 反正今天也闲着，不如把车库收拾一下，该扔的扔，堆了好几年了。
en: Since we've got nothing on today, we might as well tackle the garage and chuck out the junk that's been piling up for years.
alt: Seeing as we're free, why don't we sort out the garage and get rid of all the stuff that's been sitting there for years?
point: ‘反正闲着’ 说 since we've got nothing on；‘该扔的扔’ 说 chuck out

zh: 菜做咸了，大家凑合吃吧，下次少放点盐。
en: I've gone a bit heavy on the salt, so you'll have to make do. I'll go easier on it next time.
alt: Sorry, I've overdone the salt — you'll have to put up with it tonight, and I'll be more careful next time.
point: ‘做咸了’ 说 I've gone heavy on the salt；‘凑合吃’ 说 make do

zh: 房子是挺喜欢的，就是价格有点高，要是能便宜点，今天就能签。
en: We love the place, but the rent's a bit steep. If there's any wiggle room on the price, we'd be happy to sign today.
alt: We're really keen, but it's slightly out of our budget — if you could come down a little, we'd sign on the spot.
point: 补 we；‘能便宜点’ 说 any wiggle room on the price

zh: 不想闹僵，毕竟还要住一年，先好好说，实在不行再去仲裁。
en: I don't want to rock the boat since we've got another year here, so I'll raise it nicely first and take it to the Tribunal if that doesn't work.
alt: We've still got a year left, so I'd rather keep things friendly — I'll have a polite word first and only go to the Tribunal as a last resort.
point: ‘闹僵’ 说 rock the boat；‘不行再’ 补 if that doesn't work

zh: 早知道这样，当初就不该签两年，现在想搬也搬不了。
en: If I'd known this would happen, I'd never have signed a two-year lease. Now I'm stuck here whether I like it or not.
alt: Had I known, I wouldn't have locked myself into two years — now there's no getting out of it.
point: ‘早知道’ 用 If I'd known；‘搬不了’ 说 I'm stuck here

zh: 不想多管闲事，不过你家门好像没关，要不要回去看一眼？
en: I don't want to stick my nose in, but I think you've left your front door open. Might be worth popping back to check?
alt: Not to be nosy, but your front door looks like it's open — you might want to double-check.
point: ‘多管闲事’ 说 stick my nose in；补 you've

zh: 都是邻居，抬头不见低头见，犯不着为个车位闹翻。
en: We're neighbours and we'll be bumping into each other for years, so it's not worth falling out over a parking spot.
alt: We've got to live next to each other, so let's not fall out over something as small as a car park.
point: ‘抬头不见低头见’ 说 bumping into each other；‘犯不着’ 说 it's not worth

zh: 派对挺热闹啊，就是明天还得早起上班，音乐能稍微小点吗？
en: Sounds like a great party! I've just got an early start tomorrow, so would you mind turning the music down a notch?
alt: Looks like you're having a good time! Any chance you could turn it down a bit? I've got work early tomorrow.
point: ‘挺热闹’ 说 Sounds like a great party；‘稍微小点’ 说 down a notch

zh: 说是给我们“特别优惠”，一算比原来还贵，真当我们不会算账啊。
en: They called it a "special deal", but when you do the maths it's dearer than what we had. They must think we were born yesterday.
alt: Some "special offer" — it works out more expensive than our old plan. Do they think we can't add up?
point: 补 they；‘当我们不会算账’ 说 think we were born yesterday

zh: 这周再修不好，就只能换一家了，不是吓唬你们。
en: If it's not fixed by the end of the week, we'll have no choice but to switch providers, and that's not an empty threat.
alt: Honestly, if it's still not working by Friday, we'll be taking our business elsewhere — and I mean it.
point: 补 it's / we'll；‘不是吓唬’ 说 not an empty threat

zh: 冬天开暖气太费电了，能省就省吧，多穿件毛衣又冻不死。
en: Running the heater all winter costs a fortune, so let's save where we can. Throwing on an extra jersey never killed anyone.
alt: The heating bill in winter is eye-watering, so let's cut back where we can — a warm jersey will do the trick.
point: ‘能省就省’ 说 save where we can；毛衣在新西兰说 jersey

zh: 这个价嘛，说实话比别家高一截，还有商量的余地吗？
en: To be honest, that's quite a bit higher than the other quotes I've had. Is there any room to move on that?
alt: That's a fair bit more than the others quoted me, to be frank — could you sharpen your pencil at all?
point: ‘高一截’ 补 that's；‘商量余地’ 说 any room to move

zh: 修了三回，每回都说好了，没几天又坏，这不是白花钱吗？
en: You've been out three times now, and every time you've said it's sorted, but it packs up again within days. I'm basically throwing money away.
alt: Three call-outs, three times I've been told it's fixed, and it keeps breaking down — I'm pouring money down the drain here.
point: 补 you've / it；‘又坏’ 说 packs up；‘白花钱’ 说 throwing money away

zh: 能自己弄的就自己弄，实在搞不定再叫人，没必要什么都花钱。
en: If we can do it ourselves, we should, and only call someone in when we're out of our depth. There's no need to pay for everything.
alt: Let's DIY what we can and get a tradie in only when it's beyond us — no point paying for every little job.
point: ‘搞不定’ 说 out of our depth；‘没必要’ 补 there's no need

zh: 挂着看挺好，穿上就不是那么回事了，还是算了吧。
en: It looked great on the hanger, but it's not quite the same once it's on, so I think I'll leave it.
alt: It's one of those things that looks better on the rack than on me — I'll pass, thanks.
point: ‘不是那么回事’ 说 not quite the same；‘算了吧’ 说 I'll leave it

zh: 说是“限时特价”，其实好几个月都是这个价，别上当。
en: They're calling it a "limited-time offer", but it's been that price for months, so don't fall for it.
alt: That "limited-time offer" has been running for months — it's just a sales gimmick.
point: 补 they're / it's；‘别上当’ 说 don't fall for it

zh: 能退是能退，不过得自己付运费，想想还是留着吧。
en: I could send it back, but I'd have to cover the postage myself, so I think I'll just hang on to it.
alt: Returning it is an option, but with the postage on me, it's hardly worth it — I'll keep it.
point: ‘能退是能退’ 说 I could …, but；‘留着’ 说 hang on to it

zh: 味道还行吧，就是分量太少了，吃完回家估计还得煮碗面。
en: It was nice enough, but the portions were tiny. I'll probably have to make myself some noodles when I get home.
alt: The food was fine, but it barely touched the sides — I'll be raiding the pantry when I get back.
point: ‘还行吧’ 说 nice enough；‘还得煮面’ 补 I'll

zh: 不是挑刺，牛排要的是五分熟，这个都快全熟了，能重做一下吗？
en: I hate to be a pain, but I asked for medium and this is closer to well done. Would you mind having another go at it?
alt: Sorry to be fussy, but I ordered it medium and it's pretty much well done — could the kitchen redo it?
point: ‘不是挑刺’ 说 I hate to be a pain；‘要的是’ 补 I asked for

zh: 这顿说什么也得我来，上次你抢着付了，这次别争了。
en: This one's definitely on me. You beat me to it last time, so I won't hear another word about it.
alt: No arguments — I'm paying tonight. You snuck in and paid last time.
point: ‘说什么也得我来’ 说 definitely on me；‘抢着付’ 说 beat me to it

zh: 回报听着挺高，但天上不会掉馅饼，还是别碰为好。
en: The returns sound amazing, but if something sounds too good to be true, it probably is, so I'd steer well clear.
alt: Those returns are suspiciously high — there's no such thing as a free lunch, so I'd give it a wide berth.
point: ‘天上不会掉馅饼’ 说 too good to be true；‘别碰’ 说 steer clear

zh: 借钱这事吧，不是不想帮，就是怕伤感情，你能理解吧。
en: I'd like to help, honestly, but lending money between friends can get messy, and I'd hate for it to come between us.
alt: Please don't take this the wrong way, but I make a point of not lending money to mates — I'd hate it to spoil our friendship.
point: ‘不是不想帮’ 说 I'd like to help；‘伤感情’ 说 come between us

zh: 每个月存一点，积少成多，等反应过来已经攒了不少了。
en: If you put a bit away each month, it soon adds up, and before you know it, you've got a decent nest egg.
alt: Small amounts every month really do add up — you'll be surprised how quickly the savings grow.
point: 泛指补 you；‘积少成多’ 说 it adds up；积蓄说 nest egg

zh: 填了一上午表，最后告诉我填错了表，真是让人抓狂。
en: I spent the whole morning filling in forms, only to be told I'd filled in the wrong one. It drives me up the wall.
alt: A whole morning of paperwork, and then they tell me it was the wrong form — honestly, it's maddening.
point: 补 I；‘让人抓狂’ 说 drives me up the wall

zh: 规定就是规定，跟窗口的人吵也没用，还不如回去把材料补齐。
en: Rules are rules, and there's no point arguing with the person at the counter. You're better off going home and getting your paperwork sorted.
alt: The staff can't bend the rules, so having a go at them won't help — just go and get the missing documents.
point: ‘吵也没用’ 说 there's no point arguing；‘还不如’ 说 you're better off

zh: 电话打了一个小时，转了五个部门，最后说不归他们管。
en: I was on the phone for an hour, got passed around five departments, and then they told me it wasn't their area.
alt: After an hour of being bounced between five departments, I was told it wasn't even their responsibility.
point: 补 I / they；‘转来转去’ 说 got passed around

zh: 也没什么大事，就是老觉得累，可能最近太拼了，不过还是查一下放心。
en: It's probably nothing. I've just been feeling run-down, likely from burning the candle at both ends, but I'd like to get checked for peace of mind.
alt: I'm sure it's nothing serious — I've been overdoing it lately — but I'd like a check-up just to be on the safe side.
point: ‘没什么大事’ 说 It's probably nothing；‘太拼’ 用习语

zh: 医生说不用太担心，按时吃药多休息，过两周再看看。
en: The doctor said there's nothing to worry about. I just need to take the tablets, get plenty of rest and see how it goes in a fortnight.
alt: According to the GP it's nothing major — keep up the meds, rest up, and we'll reassess in two weeks.
point: ‘按时吃药’ 补 I just need to；‘再看看’ 说 see how it goes

zh: 你脸色不太好，今天别硬撑了，早点回家歇着吧。
en: You're looking a bit peaky. Don't push yourself today, just head home early and get some rest.
alt: You look a bit under the weather — there's no need to soldier on today, go home and put your feet up.
point: ‘脸色不好’ 补 you're looking peaky；‘别硬撑’ 说 don't push yourself

zh: 先别慌，人没事最重要，车的事明天再说。
en: Don't panic. The main thing is that nobody's hurt, and we can deal with the car tomorrow.
alt: Take a breath — what matters is that everyone's OK. The car can wait till tomorrow.
point: ‘人没事’ 说 nobody's hurt；‘明天再说’ 补 we can deal with

zh: 好在发现得早，再晚几分钟整个厨房就烧起来了。
en: Thank goodness we caught it early. Another few minutes and the whole kitchen would have gone up in flames.
alt: Lucky we spotted it when we did — any later and the whole kitchen would've been on fire.
point: ‘发现得早’ 补 we caught it；‘再晚几分钟’ 用 another few minutes and …

zh: 说是可能还有余震，今晚最好别睡楼上，有备无患嘛。
en: They're saying there could be more aftershocks, so it's probably best not to sleep upstairs tonight. Better safe than sorry.
alt: Apparently more aftershocks are likely, so I'd sleep downstairs tonight — no sense taking chances.
point: ‘说是’ 补 they're saying；‘有备无患’ 说 better safe than sorry

zh: 不是说你开得不好，就是这条路上开这么快，我有点心慌。
en: Your driving's fine, honestly, but I get a bit jumpy when we're going this fast on a road like this.
alt: I'm not criticising your driving, but this speed on this road makes me a bit nervous — could you ease off a touch?
point: 委婉批评先肯定对方；‘心慌’ 说 I get a bit jumpy

zh: 反正也赶不上了，慢慢开吧，别为了几分钟冒险。
en: We're going to be late anyway, so there's no sense in rushing. A few minutes isn't worth the risk.
alt: We've missed it regardless, so take it easy — it's not worth risking an accident to save five minutes.
point: ‘反正赶不上’ 补 we're going to be late anyway

zh: 停这儿估计要被拖走，还是停远一点，多走几步吧。
en: I reckon we'll get towed if we park here, so let's leave it a bit further away and walk.
alt: We'd be asking to get towed parking here — let's find a spot further down and walk the rest.
point: ‘估计’ 说 I reckon；‘被拖走’ 说 get towed

zh: 照片上看着挺大，到了才发现转个身都难，真是照骗。
en: It looked huge in the photos, but there's barely room to swing a cat. Talk about false advertising!
alt: The photos made it look spacious, but in reality you could hardly turn around — so much for the pictures.
point: ‘转身都难’ 说 no room to swing a cat；补 it looked

zh: 能升舱当然好，不行也无所谓，就是问问。
en: If there's any chance of an upgrade, that'd be lovely, but no worries if not. I'm just asking.
alt: I don't suppose there's an upgrade going? Totally fine if not — no harm in asking.
point: ‘不行也无所谓’ 说 no worries if not；‘就是问问’ 补 I'm just asking

zh: 行程排得太满，每天赶来赶去，回来比上班还累。
en: We crammed too much into the trip and spent every day rushing about. I came back more exhausted than when I left.
alt: We tried to fit in far too much, and by the end I needed a holiday to recover from the holiday.
point: ‘排得太满’ 说 crammed too much into；补 we / I

zh: 这儿的天说变就变，出门时还是大太阳，半小时后就下冰雹了。
en: It's four seasons in one day here. It was blazing sunshine when we left, and half an hour later it was hailing.
alt: You can't trust the weather here — glorious sun when we set off, hail thirty minutes later.
point: 天气要补 it；‘说变就变’ 说 four seasons in one day

zh: 要不今天就别登顶了，风越来越大，安全第一，山又不会跑。
en: Maybe we should turn back before the summit. The wind's getting up, and the mountain's not going anywhere.
alt: I think we should call off the summit today — the wind's picking up, and we can always come back.
point: ‘别登顶’ 补 we；‘山又不会跑’ 说 it's not going anywhere

zh: 说好只走两个小时的，结果走了五个小时，下次再也不信你了。
en: You said it'd only be a two-hour walk, and it took us five. I'm never taking your word for it again!
alt: "Just a two-hour stroll," you said — five hours later, I've learnt my lesson about trusting you!
point: 补 you said / it took us；‘不信你’ 说 taking your word for it

zh: 输就输了吧，尽力了就行，下周再扳回来。
en: You can't win them all. We gave it everything, and we'll get our own back next week.
alt: Oh well, we left it all out there — we'll make up for it next week.
point: ‘输就输了’ 说 You can't win them all；‘扳回来’ 说 get our own back

zh: 不是我说，裁判今天明显偏向主队，不过抱怨也没用。
en: I'm not one to complain, but the ref was clearly favouring the home side today. Not that moaning about it will change anything.
alt: I don't like to whinge, but the ref had it in for us today — still, there's no point crying over it.
point: ‘不是我说’ 说 I'm not one to complain, but

zh: 跑一圈就喘成这样，看来真得好好练了，不能再找借口了。
en: One lap and I'm already wheezing like this. Looks like I really need to knuckle down and stop making excuses.
alt: If one lap does this to me, it's time to get serious about training and stop making excuses.
point: ‘看来’ 说 looks like；‘好好练’ 说 knuckle down

zh: 评分挺高的，看完觉得一般，可能是期望太高了。
en: It got rave reviews, but I thought it was just OK. Maybe I went in with my expectations too high.
alt: Everyone raved about it, but it didn't do much for me — I probably built it up too much in my head.
point: 补 it / I；‘期望太高’ 说 went in with my expectations too high

zh: 本来只想看一集，结果一口气把整季看完了，天都亮了。
en: I was only going to watch one episode, but I ended up bingeing the whole season and didn't get to bed till dawn.
alt: One episode turned into the whole series, and the next thing I knew the sun was coming up.
point: 补 I；‘一口气看完’ 说 binge

zh: 唱得一般，不过图个开心嘛，别那么认真。
en: I'm no singer, I know, but it's only a bit of fun, so don't take it so seriously!
alt: I can't hold a tune to save my life, but who cares — it's just for a laugh.
point: ‘图个开心’ 说 it's only a bit of fun；补 I'm

zh: 每次都说改天吃饭，结果从来没约成，这次直接定个时间吧。
en: We always say we'll grab dinner some time and never do, so why don't we pin down a date right now?
alt: We keep saying "we must catch up" and it never happens — let's lock in a date while we're at it.
point: ‘改天’ 说 some time；‘定个时间’ 说 pin down a date

zh: 时候不早了，就不多打扰了，下次来我家，我做饭。
en: It's getting on, so I won't keep you any longer. Next time you're coming to mine, and I'll cook.
alt: I'd better let you get on with your evening — next time it's my place, and dinner's on me.
point: ‘不多打扰’ 说 I won't keep you；‘来我家’ 说 come to mine

zh: 人家没主动提，你也别问了，可能有难言之隐。
en: If she hasn't brought it up, I wouldn't ask. There might be something she'd rather not talk about.
alt: I'd leave it unless she mentions it herself — she may have her reasons for keeping quiet.
point: ‘没主动提’ 说 hasn't brought it up；‘别问’ 委婉说 I wouldn't ask

zh: 礼物嘛，心意到了就行，没必要买那么贵的。
en: It's the thought that counts, so there's really no need to splash out on something that expensive.
alt: Honestly, it's the gesture that matters — you don't have to spend a fortune.
point: ‘心意到了就行’ 说 It's the thought that counts；‘花大钱’ 说 splash out

zh: 过年回不去，视频拜个年，也算是团圆了吧。
en: We can't make it home for New Year, but a video call with the family is the next best thing, I suppose.
alt: Going home isn't on the cards this New Year, but at least we can all get together on a video call.
point: ‘回不去’ 补 we can't make it；‘也算’ 说 the next best thing

zh: 年年说要减肥，一到圣诞就破功，明年再说吧。
en: Every year I swear I'll lose weight, and every Christmas it goes out the window. I'll try again next year.
alt: My diet never survives Christmas, no matter how good my intentions — there's always next year.
point: ‘年年说’ 补 I swear；‘破功’ 说 goes out the window

zh: 孩子嘛，说了也不听，有时候就得让他自己摔一跤才知道。
en: Kids never listen when you tell them. Sometimes you've just got to let them learn the hard way.
alt: You can warn them all you like, but sometimes kids have to find out for themselves.
point: 泛指补 you；‘摔一跤才知道’ 说 learn the hard way

zh: 婆婆好心是好心，就是管得太多了，又不好直说。
en: My mother-in-law means well, but she does tend to interfere, and it's hard to say anything without causing offence.
alt: My mother-in-law's heart is in the right place, but she's a bit of a busybody, and I can't exactly tell her that.
point: ‘好心是好心’ 说 means well；‘不好直说’ 补 it's hard to say anything

zh: 一晃孩子都上高中了，感觉昨天还抱在怀里呢。
en: I can't believe he's already at high school. It feels like only yesterday I was carrying him around.
alt: Where did the time go? He's at high school now, and it seems like five minutes ago he was a baby.
point: ‘一晃’ 说 I can't believe …；‘感觉’ 补 it feels like

zh: 本来只想领养一只猫，结果领回来两只，谁让它们是一窝的呢。
en: We only went to adopt one cat and came home with two. What can you say? They were from the same litter.
alt: We went in for one cat and walked out with a pair — we couldn't bring ourselves to split up littermates.
point: 补 we；‘谁让…呢’ 说 What can you say?

zh: 养狗哪有不掉毛的，想要家里一尘不染就别养了。
en: Dog hair comes with the territory. If you want a spotless house, a dog probably isn't for you.
alt: Shedding is part of the deal with dogs — if you can't live with a bit of hair, don't get one.
point: ‘哪有不掉毛的’ 说 comes with the territory；泛指补 you

zh: 看它那么可怜，又给了一块，下次一定狠下心。
en: He gave me those puppy-dog eyes, so I caved and gave him another treat. Next time I'll be stronger, I promise.
alt: One look at his sad little face and I gave in again — I really must be firmer next time.
point: 补 he / I；‘心软了’ 说 I caved

zh: 也不是生气，就是有点失望，本来以为你会先跟我商量的。
en: I'm not angry, just a bit disappointed. I'd have thought you'd talk it over with me first.
alt: I'm not cross, I'm just a little let down — I assumed you'd run it past me before deciding.
point: ‘本来以为’ 说 I'd have thought；补 I'm / you'd

zh: 别想太多了，换谁都会这么做，又不是你的错。
en: Don't overthink it. Anyone would've done the same in your position, and it's not as if it was your fault.
alt: Stop beating yourself up — anybody would have reacted the same way, and none of this is on you.
point: ‘换谁都会’ 说 anyone would've；‘又不是’ 说 it's not as if

zh: 说出来好多了，憋在心里太难受，谢谢你听我啰嗦这么久。
en: I feel so much better for getting that off my chest. Thanks for putting up with me going on for so long.
alt: It's such a relief to finally talk about it — thanks for listening to me ramble for so long.
point: ‘说出来’ 说 get it off my chest；‘啰嗦’ 说 going on
